# HexPiece 2.3.4

Ryou's hands, done the way you asked: your own skin turns black, and the fists glow. Nothing here has been tested in game yet. The
build's checks and tests pass, and the hands were rendered and checked from six angles.

## Armament and Ryou hands
- **Your skin itself turns black.** The original mod turns your skin white for Nika by making a recoloured copy of your skin. Haki
  now does the same. While Armament or Ryou is on, you're drawn with a copy of your own skin whose hands are black, base layer and
  sleeve layer, fading up through the wrist. There is no box over the hand any more. When Haki goes off, your normal skin is back.
  While Gear 5's white skin is on, Gear's own skin is kept.
- **The fists glow.** A soft halo in your Ryou colour glows round each fist and breathes with the outline. It's built so it can't
  turn into a box on your setup.
- **The outline is brighter.** The coloured band along the hand's edges is now drawn at full brightness, unshaded.
- If your skin ever can't be read, you keep your normal skin and the old black coat is drawn over the hands instead.

## Unchanged
Everything else is as in 2.3.3. The network protocol is the same as 2.2.1.
